# Ksenia Alekseeva

> International media and growth marketing leader with 12+ years in B2C acquisition, full funnel media, experimentation and measurement. Head of Paid Media at Yango Play, a MENA streaming platform. Formerly Paid Social and Programmatic Lead at Publicis Media. Based between the UK and UAE.

## Profile
- Current role: Head of Paid Media, Yango Play (since March 2025). Leads media investment across digital (social, search, video, CTV, programmatic, affiliates) and offline. Helped scale Yango Play to 5M+ Google Play downloads and #2 among top grossing entertainment Android apps in Egypt.
- Previous: 10+ years at Publicis Media, including Paid Social and Programmatic Lead (June 2022 to February 2025) and Performance Manager to Strategy Director (January 2014 to June 2022), building a 30+ person team.
- Brands advised: Samsung, Visa, Sephora, LVMH, Commercial Bank of Dubai, NEOM, Accor.
- Markets: MENA, Europe, APAC and North America (global go to market playbooks for NEOM and Accor).
- Expertise: paid media, growth marketing, user acquisition, incrementality testing, marketing mix modelling, attribution, brand lift, AI creative production, dynamic creative optimisation, programmatic, paid social, TikTok advertising.
- Education: Master's in Journalism, Lomonosov Moscow State University, Diploma of Excellence.
- Languages: English, Russian.

- Samsung AI personalisation (DCO): 600 personalised creatives, 2x response rate: https://lbbonline.com/news/ai-powered-personalisation-at-scale/

- Sephora 76% higher ROAS; Samsung 21x more orders on Meta: https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en-US/inspiration/sephora-583
